name: Sóley — Iceland travel and direct booking
description:
Plan and book Iceland inside Claude, with live answers from the country itself.

Ask about conditions and get the real picture, right now: weather, road closures, safety alerts, avalanche risk, aurora forecasts, earthquakes, flights, public buses, fuel prices, air quality, exchange rates and Icelandic news. Straight from Iceland's national data sources, in your conversation.

Ask about places and people, and get the whole country, not just whoever paid to be seen. Sóley carries more than 3,500 listings built from Iceland's national licence register of 3,800+ tourism operators: licensed hotels, guesthouses, tour companies and rentals from Reykjavík to the smallest fjord. Nothing is sponsored, and ranking is never for sale.

When an operator is connected for booking, you can finish the whole trip in one conversation: check real availability, get a price in your currency, reserve, and pay on the operator's own payment page. Sóley never holds your money and never sees your card. You book directly with the local company; they keep the booking, you keep a human counterparty, and you can message them and get their reply back in the chat.

Iceland's tourism is run by local companies. Sóley puts them one question away.

Sóley is operated by Cognia ehf in Iceland.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sóley — Iceland travel and direct booking to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sóley — Iceland travel and direct booking to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.soley.travel/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sóley — Iceland travel and direct booking MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sóley — Iceland travel and direct booking lists 30 MCP tools, including cancel_booking, check_availability, check_operator_replies, create_booking, get_about_soley, get_air_quality, get_aurora_forecast, get_avalanche_conditions, get_booking_status, get_bus_routes, get_bus_schedule, and get_earthquakes.
